authors.bio: Maurice L. French is the SMPTE Editorial Vice-president. A founding member of the Society in Canada, he was Chairman of the Toronto Section for three terms and served consecutively for 20 years on the Section Board of Managers. He is a recipient of the SMPTE's Outstanding Service Citation. Mr. French was Program Chairman of the 116th Technical Conference and General Arrangements Chairman of the 14th Annual SMPTE Television Conference. He has served two terms as Governor of the Canadian Region. He is an SMPTE Fellow. He received the Centennial Medal of Canada in recognition of valuable service to the nation. Mr. French is with the Canadian Broadcasting Corporation in Toronto.
